title: Feature and electronics not working
summary: This topic centers on vague mentions of things not working, with the clearest examples pointing to electronics, app behavior, and setup compatibility issues, while many fragments lack enough context to identify the exact feature.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the vehicle overall or express appreciation for the work performed rather than a specific feature function.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe electronics, setup, or unspecified features that do not work properly or at all.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews often mention something not working or needing help to operate features, but the fragments usually do not identify the exact system clearly enough for a firmer summary.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are too short or vague to identify the specific component or feature involved.
The cluster mixes possible hardware, software, app, training, and service-work references under the broad term 'work'.
One negative example about the app appears in an undetermined fragment, so the available evidence for clearly negative app issues is limited within the negative-labeled sample.
